{{Quote|Carved horned lava-rock obelisks guard the front approach to the castle, warning off enemies and boasting of the murderous prowess of the marauders.|Pfilbee Jhorn|<ref name="Illustrated">''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]''</ref>}}
On the [[Endor/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor (planet)/Legends|Endor]], the shipwrecked [[Pirate/Legends|pirates]] known as the [[Sanyassan Marauders/Legends|Sanyassan Marauders]] erected [[Magma/Legends|lava]]-rock '''obelisks''' to scare potential invaders away from their [[Terak's Keep|fortified barracks]].<ref name="Illustrated" /> The Marauders' obelisks were frequently carved into horned, grimacing faces with a gaping mouth.<ref name="BFE">''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''</ref>

At some point between [[0 ABY/Legends|0 ABY]] and [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]],<ref name="Galaxies">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref><ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Sergeant/Legends|sergeant]] [[Pfilbee Jhorn]] scouted the forest moon's surface and discovered the Marauders. In his mission reports, Jhorn mentioned in passing the presence of intimidating monoliths around the pirates' castle.<ref name="Illustrated" />

In [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]], while en route to the stronghold in a mission to free their friend [[Cindel Towani]] from the Marauder's clutches, the [[Ewok/Legends|Ewok]] [[Wicket Wystri Warrick/Legends|Wicket Warrick]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] hermit [[Noa Briqualon]] came across several of those horned pillars scattered upon the [[Dragon's Pelt/Legends|Dragon's Pelt]] savanna. The fast-paced individual know as [[Teek (Teek)|Teek]] even bumped into one, and was frightened by its awe-inspiring appearance.<ref name="BFE" />

==Behind the scenes==
The menacing obelisks erected by the Marauders first appeared in the [[1985]] made-for-TV film ''[[Ewoks: The Battle for Endor]]''.<ref name="BFE" /> They were also featured in ''[[The Ring, the Witch, and the Crystal: An Ewok Adventure]]'', a children's book adaptation of the movie,<ref name="RWC">''[[The Ring, the Witch, and the Crystal: An Ewok Adventure]]''</ref> and received a brief mention in ''[[The Illustrated Star Wars Universe]]'', a [[1995]] reference book.<ref name="Illustrated" />
